native_retrieval.title: Condonation of Delay
native_retrieval.snippet: * Recently the High Court of Delhi in the case of **Dept. Kamla Mehndiratta & Ors.**, has observed that **condonation of delay is an exception** which should not be used as per convenience of the Government departments. * The petitioner filed the **writ petition** challenging order of the Labour Court before the Delhi High Court and vide order dated 15th March 2007 the matter was listed in the category of Regular Matters. * Justice Chandra Dhari Singh observed that **condonation of delay is an exception which should not be used as per convenience of the Government departments.**. * The Court further said that the **averments made in the application for a delay of 691 days cannot be classified as a reasonable delay** in any manner. * The provision of Section 5 of LA **does not necessarily imply that the power of the court to condone the delay is circumscribed** by an application being filed.
